# Catalog validator caps - generated reference

Single source of truth for the numeric caps the `code-comments` and `documentation-layout` validators enforce. Generated from the validator constants, so the caps can never drift between code and prose. Point here by reference rather than restating a number. To change a cap, edit the constant in the validator and run `ward exec gen-caps-reference`, never this file.

Constants live in [`agentic_os/pre_commit/check_code_comments.py`](../agentic_os/pre_commit/check_code_comments.py) and [`agentic_os/pre_commit/check_documentation_layout.py`](../agentic_os/pre_commit/check_documentation_layout.py).

## code-comments

* **comment line chars** - 90 - max characters on a standalone comment line.
* **contiguous comment lines** - 2 - max consecutive comment lines after content begins (a top-of-file header block is exempt).

## documentation-layout

* **markdown lines** - 80 - non-blank lines for most `.md` files.
* **markdown chars** - 4000 - characters for most `.md` files.
* **README overview lines** - 160 - non-blank lines for the root README.md.
* **README overview chars** - 12500 - characters for the root README.md.
* **FEATURES.md lines** - 80 - non-blank lines for docs/FEATURES.md.
* **FEATURES.md chars** - 4000 - characters for docs/FEATURES.md.
* **AGENTS.md lines (default)** - 320 - AGENTS.md shared default (override per-repo with `agents_md_max_lines`).
* **AGENTS.md chars (default)** - 25000 - AGENTS.md shared default (override per-repo with `agents_md_max_chars`).
* **README.md lines (default)** - 160 - the root README.md defaults to the trifecta line cap (override per-repo with `readme_max_lines`).
* **README.md chars (default)** - 12500 - the root README.md defaults to the trifecta char cap (override per-repo with `readme_max_chars`).
* **module README lines** - 3 - non-blank lines for a co-located module README (outpost or homestead shape).
* **module README prose chars** - 90 - characters per prose line in a module README (the pointer line is exempt).
